key_insight: A ReS2/hBN/InSe van der Waals floating-gate transistor integrates nonvolatile memory, broadband optoelectronic synaptic learning, and adaptive logic in one device.
engineering_relevance: The platform could support compact neuromorphic hardware that combines optical sensing, memory, and information processing.
method: Stack a photoresponsive ReS2 channel, hBN tunneling dielectric, and InSe floating gate.
Modulate stored charge and synaptic conductance using visible-to-near-infrared light and electrical pulses.
Demonstrate synaptic plasticity, Pavlovian-inspired conditioning, and reconfigurable Boolean logic.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports an on/off current ratio exceeding 10^6, stable multilevel conductance, retention over 10^4 s, and bidirectional optical potentiation/electrical depression.
watch_item: Array-scale integration, device variability, endurance, and energy per operation are not established in the abstract.
paper_title: A van der Waals Floating-Gate Platform for Broadband Optoelectronic Neuromorphic Computing
